title: Wet Dreams
director: Lasse Braun, Max Fischer, Oscar Gigard
writer: Art Epstein, Max Fischer, Heinz Freitag
plot: Experimental anthology film consisting of nine segments - Contrasts, The Janitor, The Plumber, Another Wet Dream, The Happy Necrophiliacs, On a Sunday Afternoon, A Face, Politfuck, Flames - all focused on 70s sex, love and politics.
